title: ExtractionRequest
description: Request body for on-demand data extraction operations.

@odata.type.description: OData type specifying the extraction type, such as EndOfDayPricingExtractionRequest or TermsAndConditionsExtractionRequest.

ContentFieldNames.description: List of field names to include in the extraction.

IdentifierList.description: Specification of instruments for the extraction.

@odata.type.description: OData type for the identifier list, such as InstrumentIdentifierList.

IdentifierType.description: Type of identifier such as Ric, Isin, or Cusip.

Condition.description: Extraction conditions such as date range and query parameters.
